data.description: You preserve the remains of a dead creature so that they do not decay. Doing so effectively extends the time limit on raising that creature from the dead [see raise dead]. Days spent under the influence of this spell don't count against the time limit. Additionally, this spell makes transporting a slain [and thus decaying] comrade less unpleasant. The spell also works on severed body parts and the like.
